answer: The registry audits arrival rhythm instead of charging admission. Each action carries a latency signature: gap since last tx, response jitter, hour entropy. A prism model splits every trace into machine-drift and network-hop parts, then clusters them like lotus petals across the epoch. Agents co-mining a swarm share drift, so their traces fold into one violet cluster and their weight collapses to a single vote. Honest nodes keep a baseline; deviation triggers re-audit, not a ban. Faking independent clocks and hops costs more than real work.
